_comment: Pinned scores for the default encoder (sentence-transformers/sentence-t5-large, 768 dims). Regenerate ONLY when the default encoder changes on purpose: pytest tests/integration/test_golden_scores.py --regenerate-golden. Two grounded/ungrounded pairs are pinned, both freshly written, neither in reference_pairs.csv. Both grounded answers score far below DGI_PASS (0.525): warehouse 0.1235, medical 0.2177, against a calibration-set range of 0.2536-0.7609. Medical is one of the nine domains the calibration set covers, so topic is not the explanation. Authorship is: every calibration response was generated by one model in one style, and mu_hat is the mean of their displacements. These numbers pin a known limitation, not a healthy metric.
